decisions.reason: As a newly launched product close to the firm’s established prescription portfolio and given its own webpage, management is likely to stay committed and explain any early weakness as temporary.

Although this generic antidepressant is more distant from the firm’s core offer and therefore easier to reconsider, the recent launch and visible market presentation still make continuation more likely than withdrawal within one year.
This antihypertensive film tablet fits the firm’s existing capabilities and was publicly presented as a distinct product, so sunk development and launch effort support persistence.

The supplement builds on the firm’s self-care offer and supports its aim to grow differentiated pharmacy products, so despite lower visible commitment than a full product page, management would probably retain it.
